title: Alpha Dhabi net profit surges 48% to $2.7bln in H1 2026

contentHtml:
Trojan General Contracting LLC, one of the portfolio companies of Alpha Dhabi, is the builder of Abu Dhabi's Zayed International Airport. Credit: Alpha Dhabi

Revenue rose 5% to AED 37.6 billion

Staff Writer ,  ZAWYA

ADX-listed Alpha Dhabi Holding has posted a 48% year-on-year increase in net profit for H1 2026 to AED 9.8 billion ($2.7 billion), while revenue rose by 5% to AED 37.6 billion, reflecting continued growth across its diversified portfolio.
